similar_bugs.title: Login API crashes with NullPointerException
similar_bugs.description: Users cannot login with valid credentials. Login API throws NullPointerException because the user object is null.
similar_bugs.root_cause: An object is null before a method or property is accessed.
similar_bugs.resolution: Investigate the java.lang.NullPointerException at User.getUsername(). Review application logs and reproduce the issue. Address the identified root cause: An object is null before a method or property is accessed. Apply the fix and verify the original scenario.

similar_bugs.title: Login API Throws NullPointerException
similar_bugs.root_cause: The NullPointerException reported in AuthenticationService.authenticate() -> UserRepository.findByUsername() is the most probable cause of the observed application failure.
similar_bugs.resolution: The issue should be resolved by addressing the identified root cause, reviewing historical resolutions, and following software engineering best practices.

similar_bugs.title: Login API Throws NullPointerException
similar_bugs.root_cause: The NullPointerException reported in AuthenticationService.authenticate() is the most probable cause of the observed application failure.
similar_bugs.resolution: The issue should be resolved by addressing the identified root cause, reviewing historical resolutions, and following software engineering best practices. Review the AuthenticationService.authenticate() method and verify that all input parameters are properly validated to prevent NullPointerException. Ensure that null values are handled correctly and that the method is not sending any null values to external APIs. Update the code to handle the specific exception that is being thrown, instead of catching a generic NullPointerException. Investigate the root cause of the issue and identify if there is a problem with data serialization or deserialization between the client and server. Implement proper validation and sanitization of user input to prevent such issues in the future. Review Nav4's handling of data from the login form and ensure that it matches the expected format.
